headline: That's it: after 75 years, the legendary sparkling wine factory closes for good, and the trouble is huge
summary: The closure, made for economic reasons, directly affects around sixty employees. Professional organisations say up to a third of domestic vineyards could be affected.
why: Sparkling wine producers buy grapes from local growers, so a plant closure can squeeze agricultural incomes and regional food and beverage supply chains.
